threads.title: Kara-Oi talks: they will walk out, you watch

posts.body:
So. The talks at Kara-Oi. UN mission headquarters, the DPI on one side, the clan delegates on the other, first time in one room since Bishkek 2007. IradOne says [b]"historic"[/b].

When IradOne says historic, check your wallet.

My prediction, write it down: the tribal side walks out before the end of May. The DPI will offer them something that looks generous on paper and is empty in the middle, like a Chicago doughnut.

WAKE UP IRAD
I hope you are wrong. My parish is praying for the talks this Sunday, including the people who think it is pointless. Maybe especially them.

In Nurzhan nobody is watching Kara-Oi this month, we have our own funeral (see Labor thread). But I tell you what the old men at the depot say: DPI will offer seats. Clans want water. You cannot pay for water with chairs.

[quote=depo_Nurzhan]DPI will offer seats. Clans want water.[/quote]
Comrade from the depot understands everything. They will offer chairs. Nice chairs, leather. The mountains stay in Talas's pocket.

First post, hello. I have a cousin who works in the building at Kara-Oi (catering side, not the important side). He says the DPI paper has numbers for seats, and there is a second paper about "catchment management" that the clan side has heard about but not seen.

He says the elders sit very quiet. That is all I know. Please nobody ask which cousin.
CATCHMENT. You see? They want the WATER. Welcome, cousin. Tell your cousin the forum says hello.
Welcome. A cousin is fine. The name of a cousin is not. Read the rules.

IT HAPPENED. They walked out. TODAY. My neighbour heard it on the radio in the bakery, the whole queue went quiet.

One third of the seats. ONE THIRD. The clans hold two thirds of the land and they are offered one third of the chairs. Who wrote this offer? A child with a calculator?

I said before the end of May. It is the 18th. I am EARLY. Notebook, page 12.

WAKE UP IRAD

My cousin says the hall emptied in about four minutes. The old Karakoyun aksakal went out with them, slowly, and nobody spoke until he was through the door. Catering had made plov for 200. He brought some home. It was good plov. Sad plov.

Herald this morning, Bektur Zhumabek uulu at the door:

[quote]The mountains were given by God to the horses and the herds, not to the stock exchanges of Talas.[/quote]

Print it. Put it on your wall. And the DPI spokesman says the proposals "remain on the table". So does the plov.
A sad day whichever side you are on. A table with only one side sitting at it is just furniture.
Water papers. I told you. Old men at the depot are never wrong about two things: water and pensions.
Hello, I added the Kara-Oi news to the news box on the Irad Internet Portal. It shows only in Internet Explorer. Sorry if broken
reading this at work. my boss says the talks will restart in autumn. my boss also said the printer would be fixed in autumn 2009

Bump. TWO YEARS today. No new talks. No date. "Remains on the table." That table must be very dusty now.

Meanwhile they are getting ready to remove the term limit (other thread). For that they don't need the clans. For that they only need 53 hands.

WAKE UP IRAD
My cousin left that job last year. He says the big plov pot is still in the kitchen. Nobody has used it since.

My father is from Kara-Buura. He says the next talks will happen when somebody in Talas needs the clans more than the clans need Talas. He has been saying it since 2008, word for word, at every family dinner.

threads.title: Labor Party will not survive the Parties Act

posts.body:
Hello. Railway, Depot No. 2, Nurzhan, 31 years. Labor Party member since March 1993, first meeting was in a canteen with no chairs.

Now they tell us: Political Parties Act 2010. 10,000 members, and 500 in each of eight constituencies. We have Nurzhan. We have the rail towns. We do not have 500 members in places where there is no railway and no refinery, because who would join a workers' party there? The law is cut to the size of one party. Guess which one.

Re-registration is next month. I will tell you what happens.

Welcome comrade. In my notebook: 2010 Parties Act, DPI spokesman says it "applies equally to all parties".

A shoe that fits only one foot also applies equally to all feet.

WAKE UP IRAD
Welcome. Strange times when a railwayman from Nurzhan and an Old City boy from Talas agree in the first two posts. Keep us posted.

Update. Commission rejected 1,900 of our signature forms. Reason: "address format".

Address format! Half of Nurzhan still writes the old Kobozev street names. The signs changed. The people did not.
ADDRESS FORMAT. Writing it down. In capitals.

It is finished. The party is dissolved.

Today we had the last meeting, same canteen as 1993. Somebody brought vodka, somebody brought the 1993 banner, nobody brought a speech. We sang one song badly and went home.

The card stays in my drawer.
Respect. I am not Labor, Labor is too Russian for me and they backed Toktarov in 2007, you know it. But a party should die by votes. Not by "address format".
Yes, we backed him in 2007. Everybody backed him in 2007. You also, I think.

...I was on my roof in 2007 with a flag. Ok. Everybody was on the roof.

WAKE UP IRAD (including me)
so who do people in nurzhan vote for in november now
Independents. NurGaz civic lists. Bekzatov said in January "a country that was saved from a sale should not be put in a single pocket". Very nice sentence. Still single pocket.

Bump. depo, are you still around? Shift B wants to know if the Labor Association still does New Year parcels for the depot pensioners. My neighbour got one. The tin of sprats had the old party logo on it.
Still here. Yes, the parcels continue. The sprats are from old stock. Like me.

threads.title: 2011 election: guess the number (no prizes)

posts.body:
Election is 8 November. Toktarov and Tologonov against two men from the DPI's own phone book.

GAME: guess the official percentage, two decimals. Closest wins nothing, because this is Irad.

I start: [b]96.40[/b]. After 2007 they like a big number.

WAKE UP IRAD
91.11. it looks nice on a poster

I said to myself I would not play this game. 85.

And a reminder: vote or don't vote according to your conscience. No posting who your neighbours voted for.

88.7

I made an election night counter for the Portal, it will update automatically when the result comes. sorry if broken

Dear all, Iradis abroad cannot vote, so I can only guess, and I guess with a heavy heart: 82.00. I hope it is much lower.

One small good thing: the OSCE has announced a limited observation mission. It is not much. It is something.
82, Uncle? That is a Chicago number. Here we think bigger. But welcome to the game, you are allowed to lose with us.
At the depot we have a pool, 2 som per guess. 90.0 is the favourite. I put 87.5. I am a pessimist about their optimism.
My cousin (a different cousin) works in a print shop. He says the victory posters are already printed. He did not see a number on them. There is a white space where the number goes.
THEY LEFT A SPACE. The number is in a drawer somewhere, waiting.
Delivered ballot boxes to Chu District Thursday. They were already heavy. Joke. Probably. 93.
Chu, please be careful with jokes like that. In a week somebody will quote it as a fact on another website. Read the rules.

Polls closed one hour ago. IradOne already says "decisive". They have not finished counting and it is already DECISIVE.

WAKE UP IRAD

88.74.

Erbol guessed 88.7.

ERBOL.
I am not DPI!!! I just took the 2007 feeling and made it a little bit less. Also my counter showed "Loading" the whole night so I did not even know. sorry
Erbol is the winner of nothing. Congratulations, Erbol. Nobody is accusing anybody of anything. Ak.

I accuse nobody. I NOTE.

Notebook, page 41: Erbol8645, 88.7, suspiciously good at guessing.

(joke Erbol. You are the most innocent man in Irad, your website cannot even count its own visitors)
Depot pool won by the sweeper. 88.8. He says he looked at the Governor's face on the television for a long time and the number came to him. Nobody can argue with this method.

88.74%. The OSCE note will say there was no genuine competition. They will be right, and this year it will change nothing.

But keep writing these things down, Ak. Your notebook is history, even when we argue about everything else.

Thank you Uncle. Then help me with one more line for the notebook: [b].74[/b]

Who chooses the .74? Somewhere there is a man in an office whose job is decimals. I want to meet him. I want to shake his hand and then I want to ask him who he called.

WAKE UP IRAD
bumping because in three weeks we play again. erbol are you in. i will never forgive myself for 91.11
I am in. 80. Lower this time, I have a feeling. (please nobody write a notebook page about me)

80.

Erbol. Do not do this to me twice.

threads.title: Boz-Korgon: cement trucks on the Chu road every night

posts.body:
New here. I drive Nurzhan to Chu District at night, fuel and building materials.

Since summer: cement trucks, every night, turning off about 40 km east of Nurzhan onto the road with no sign. Escort cars front and back. Before this year, maybe one truck a week. Now six, seven a night.

Somebody is building something big at Boz-Korgon. Or finishing it.

THE BUSH PALACE. Everybody in Talas knows. Built for the Bush family in the 2000s, payment for walking away in 2006. And now a family is moving in. Which family? Ask the cement.

WAKE UP IRAD
Welcome, Chu, and thank you for no names. Ak, "everybody knows" is not a source.
I don't know about Bush. I know cement. Also one night three horse trailers. Nice ones. Aluminium.
HORSE TRAILERS. Stables for the palace. It is all in the FreeIrad article, read it.

A gentle point, if I may. When I lived in Alatau Heights in the late 90s, the compound east of Nurzhan was already being built, by the territorial administration, as an emergency site. A neighbour of mine typed up tender documents for it. It is older than any Bush visit.

That does not mean nobody lives there now. Chu's cement is cement.
Your neighbour typed the tenders. Of course he did. Amerikanka knows everything about the palace except who it is for. Interesting.
Escort cars are Gendarmerie now, not private security. Changed this month.
My cousin's friend (yes, I know) delivered furniture there. He says: a very big kitchen. A kitchen for many people.
every rumour on this forum ends in a kitchen
I tried to find Boz-Korgon on the satellite map for the Portal. There is only grey. Maybe my computer
NOT your computer, Erbol. GREY. Boz-Korgon means GREY FORTRESS and the satellite shows grey. They are laughing at us.

HERALD TODAY: "Governor's Family Takes Up Residence at Boz-Korgon". Property filings, Chu District land register. The family is there SINCE 2011.

Chu was RIGHT in September. The cement was RIGHT.

WAKE UP IRAD

And the same article says construction began in 1995 as a continuity-of-government site, and that "no document transferring title to anyone has been found". So: the family lives there, yes. The Bush part, no.

[quote=UncleTemir_Chicago]no document transferring title to anyone has been found[/quote]
Uncle. Read that sentence slowly. NOT FOUND. That is what people say when they did not look very hard.
Told you. Cement doesn't lie. Road still has no sign though.
In 1992 rich men also built strong houses outside the city. When the guns came, strong houses did not help much. I do not think about it more than that.
Bump. The road has a sign now. "Restricted area. State property." Took four years.
progress

posts.body: Heard (cousin, of course): the Governor's eldest, Ruslan, is getting the whole Gendarmerie. Not deputy. Commander. Announcement next week.

Of course. The son who went to tank school in OMSK. Russia trained him, the Americans taught him courses at the air base, and now he gets four thousand jandarms and every checkpoint on the line.

WAKE UP IRAD
This is the plot of Zalmax's Dominion. The father gives the son the cavalry, and in the third reel the son starts looking at the father's chair. I am only saying. Karimov saw it in 1977.
kino. KINO. This is the first useful thing you have posted on this forum.

They write it like it is a CV. It IS a CV. Fuel. Base. Family. Gendarmerie. Draw the line yourself, I am tired of drawing it for you.

The same profile says he is a member of our Church and plays ulak for a Gendarmerie team. I mention it only so nobody here writes this week that he is a Muslim agent or a Russian Orthodox agent. He is ours, for better or worse.
Saw the Gendarmerie ulak team at a spring game outside Talas. He plays. He's not bad. His horse is better than him. A Chongtor, sadly for me.
Even golden_doran admits it. Akyel for selling, Chongtor for the people, and now Chongtor for the Gendarmerie too. They take EVERYTHING.

Second medal. WAKE UP IRAD

threads.title: Is FreeIrad making things up? (honest question)

posts.body:
I read this site because the Herald won't print half of what people say in kitchens. Fine. But look at the articles. "Secret Bush Family Palatial Complex". "The Iradi Horse Trade: A CIA Front". "Hidden US bases". Sources: "a former contractor". "A groom." Every headline is a question with a question mark, and a question is not a fact.

The Herald found the Boz-Korgon filings, with documents, and the documents say construction started in 1995. So which is it?

I'm not DPI. I want the opposition to be RIGHT. Which means it has to be careful.

"Not DPI", he says. Every DPI says "I am not DPI".

The question mark is there because they cannot PROVE it YET, because the DPI has the documents. You want the documents? Write to Boz-Korgon and ask for the documents. Tell me how it goes.
So the absence of evidence is evidence. Convenient.

The absence of evidence is evidence of a DPI.

WAKE UP IRAD
honestly you're both right and that's why this forum is better than television

I think source_please asks a fair question, and I say that as a man who owns a FreeIrad shirt. In Chicago in the 90s we had a community newsletter that printed every rumour from home. Some were true. The true ones got lost among the others, and that was the real damage.

Careful is not the same thing as cowardly.
Uncle has a SHIRT. Uncle also had a newsletter. Uncle has everything except a gas bill in Talas.
Ak, the gas bill again. Argue the question, not the man. The question is a good one.

In 1992 the radio said every day for six weeks that the Americans were coming. People said it was a lie. Then they came. The same radio said many other things that were lies. You have to wait and see. That is all I know about sources.

WE PROTECT SOURCES. WE DO NOT PROTECT FEELINGS.

WE ASK QUESTIONS BECAUSE NOBODY ELSE IN IRAD IS ALLOWED TO. IF YOU HAVE A DOCUMENT, YOU KNOW WHERE THE TIP PAGE IS.
That's a fair answer, actually. Thank you. I still think the horse article is nonsense.
THE HORSE ARTICLE IS NONSENSE. Thank you. Nobody hides anything in a horsebox. The horse eats it.
golden_doran defends the Syndicate. Who pays for your Hippodrome ticket?
I do. 3 som. East stand.

Read this whole thread on my lunch break. The Bush thing: my uncle in Kara-Buura believed it in 2005 and he still does. It's like a family heirloom by now. That doesn't make it true. It also doesn't make a walled compound with no road sign less creepy.
For the record: my cousin is real. Everyone keeps asking.
nobody asked
The members only archive on freeirad never logs me in. Is that the cover-up? (joke) (maybe)
THE LOGIN IS FINE.
Source?

threads.title: Akyel Syndicate and Mirlan Toktarov: who checks the horsebox?

posts.body:
Akyel Syndicate. Founded 1995. Every papered Akyel that flies to Dubai or Kentucky or Hong Kong goes through them. Who is at the top now? The NEPHEW. Mirlan Toktarov.

A Toktarov in charge of the only Iradi thing that crosses every border without a visa. And FreeIrad asks the right question: who checks the horsebox?

WAKE UP IRAD
Ak, the Syndicate keeps the stud book. Without it nobody abroad would buy one horse from us. It's boring. Pedigrees. Blood tests. Export papers. I'd love it to be a spy film but it's a spreadsheet.
A spreadsheet run by the NEPHEW.
Every Talasfilm western has a nephew. He is never good news. (Except in Zarina. In Zarina the nephew is fine.)
Drove a Syndicate box to the airport once. Two mares, one groom, a lot of papers, nothing else. Groom slept the whole way. If that's the CIA it's a very sleepy CIA.
My cousin says Mirlan was at the spring meeting at the Hippodrome in a white suit. That's all he saw. The suit.

Autumn meeting today: the Syndicate sold two yearlings to a Hong Kong buyer right there at the rail. Price in dollars, not som. I heard "a very good number". That's where the money goes. Not to spies. To Hong Kong.
TO HONG KONG. And from Hong Kong to WHO? You never follow the money one step further. One step! WAKE UP IRAD
My aunt sells laghman by the Hippodrome on race days. She says the Syndicate men tip well and argue about pedigrees like grandmothers argue about weddings. Spies would be quieter.
Lena, spies who tip well is EXACTLY the profile.
Then my aunt has been feeding the CIA laghman for years and they never once complained. Good. Our laghman is international.

threads.title: Term limit: they're going to remove it before summer

posts.body: Heard: the DPI deputies will vote to remove the two-term limit from the Elective Governor Acts before summer. My cousin (a new one, he knows a deputy's driver) says the date is already set.

OF COURSE. 2007 to 2011 counts as his first term, 2011 to 2015 the second. In 2015 he would have to go home. Can't have that.

Governor until the sun goes out.

WAKE UP IRAD
A cousin who knows a deputy's driver. That's three steps from anything. I'll wait for the order paper.
You will wait for the order paper while they WRITE the order paper. Enjoy waiting.
If this is true, it's the big one. The 1992 Acts were the one thing they couldn't touch without looking like exactly what they are.
My late father was proudest of one line in the 1992 Acts. Four years, twice, then go home. "Like Washington," he used to say. I hope the cousin is wrong.
"Like Washington." Of course. Uncle, Washington left Irad in 2006 and left the term limit behind like a cat left with the neighbours. Now the cat is dying and you are sad about Washington.
Long night in here. Let's wait for the vote. And no personal remarks, please. Temir mentioned his late father.

SATURDAY SESSION. They voted on a SATURDAY so nobody would watch.

53 for. 4 against. 3 abstained. The four against are the Nurzhan deputies.

Four people in the whole Mejlis. Write their courage down somewhere, because IradOne won't.

WAKE UP IRAD
Order paper confirmed. Fine. You were right, and the cousin was right. Noted.
The cousin says thank you.
Our Nurzhan deputies. Former Labor, now "independents". The party is dead, but four votes are alive.
Refinery canteen TV had IradOne News on at lunch. "Mejlis strengthens stability." Somebody switched it to the football. Nobody switched it back.
I am old enough to remember a ruler who never left. It did not end well for him or for us. I will not say more.
I made a page on the Portal: "Term limits 1992-2013", black background. So far it is only the title. Coming soon
Supreme Court declined to hear the challenge today. "A matter for the legislature." Five justices, a short order. The petitioners' lawyer says there is no further remedy in the ISEZ courts.

A matter for the legislature. The legislature is the DPI. The court is the DPI's furniture. Legislature, court, legislature. A circle. Every road in this country is a circle.

WAKE UP IRAD
My own opinion, no cousins: a court that says "not my job" is the most honest thing a court in this country has said for years.
Lena, you are new, welcome, but that is not honesty. That is SURRENDER with a stamp.
Ak, I've been here one month and I already know you would say "surrender with a stamp" about the weather.
The weather in this country IS surrender with a stamp.
So in 2015 he can stand again. That's all this ever was. Ask anyone in a year and a half.

threads.title: Bekzatov has turned against Toktarov. Real or theatre?

posts.body: Since the term-limit vote, Bekzatov's people all over Nurzhan are saying the Governor "forgot who carried him in 2007". The Nurzhan deputies voted against. Is the old man really turning, or is this a show for the Russos?
At the refinery nobody thinks he's "turning". He turned in 2010 with the Parties Act. Labor was his workers' party. You don't kill a man's workers' party and expect a birthday card.

Bekzatov = MOSCOW. He made Toktarov in 2007 with NurGaz money and now he wants him smaller so Moscow can be bigger. Two wallets fighting. Enjoy the show, but nobody in it is on your side.

WAKE UP IRAD
Ak, he is an oligarch, yes. But in January 2011 he said "single pocket" in the newspaper. Nobody else with money said anything at all. I take what I get.
You take what you get. And what you get is a Russian pipeline.
The pipeline goes to Shymkent. It's the Feeder. Shift B can draw it for you on a napkin.
Shymkent, Moscow. From Talas it is the same direction.
Heard: Bekzatov in Moscow this week for "commercial talks". After Crimea everybody in Talas suddenly looks at Nurzhan differently.
Everybody in Talas looks at Nurzhan differently every two years. We look back the same way. He goes to Moscow every spring. NurGaz sells oil, Moscow sells pipe and machines. It's not a referendum.
The new front-page article says "secret meetings". With whom? Where? Two sources, both "a person familiar". I'm sceptical, and I'm a Talas boy who doesn't even like Bekzatov.
source_please would ask for sources at his own funeral.
Yes.
Two Talas boys and a Nurzhan refinery man arguing about Moscow at midnight. The only person who knows anything is Bekzatov, and he is not on FREECHAT.
The Russo families in Toronto are very quiet this spring. That tells me more than the article does.

threads.title: Talas Air Base fuel contracts: who's getting rich?

posts.body: Kara-Bulak here, I live where the planes go over the maize. Contractor trucks every day. The fuel tankers going into the base: same three companies for years. One of them used to be the family business the Herald profile said Ruslan did security for. Nobody says it changed hands. Nobody says it didn't.

THERE it is. The base drinks fuel. The family sells fuel. The son commands the checkpoints the fuel goes through. A circle again. All roads in Irad are circles.

WAKE UP IRAD
"Nobody says it didn't" is doing a lot of work in that post.
True. I'm telling you what my neighbours say at the shop. I sell kymyz to the contractor drivers. They're Iradis mostly. They complain about the same things you do.
Fuel runs to the base pay double. You need a pass. You get the pass from the Gendarmerie. That's all I'll say.
Chu said everything in four sentences. WAKE UP IRAD
In the territory years the base contracts were posted on a board at the gate, in English, with company names. People complained even then. Now nobody posts anything. Maybe that is the bigger change.
In the territory years. When the Americans ran everything and posted it in ENGLISH on a BOARD. Very transparent. Uncle misses the board.
Update: more night flights since autumn than before. The contractors say "Afghanistan drawdown". Trucks leave full, come back full. Make of it what you want.
Drawdown means things go out. Things going out need fuel. Our refinery had a good autumn. That's the whole conspiracy from where I stand.
FreeIrad's bases article talks about a "sixth site" in a valley of the Talas district. Kara-Bulak, you live there. Seen a sixth site?
I've seen a lot of maize.

threads.title: Adil's company suing the Herald?

posts.body: Heard from a friend who works near the Herald: Talas Commercial Development Group (Adil Toktarov's company, the one that owns Tulpar) is suing them for libel over last year's stories on the avenue land transfers. Talas District Court.

Adil has the football club, the avenue, the new arena, and now he wants the newspaper's wallet. A son for every industry. Guns, cameras, land, freight, flour.

WAKE UP IRAD
Same company rebuilt the Silk Road Arena this year. Nice seats, I hear. Bolted down properly, unlike ours.
ours are bolted down now as well. since May. don't ask me how i know
Verdict: one point upheld, a correction and 200,000 som. The rest dismissed. So the Herald got most of it right and pays anyway.
200,000 som for the truth. That's 40,000 dollars. Cheap for them. Expensive for the truth. And the next reporter learns the price list.

For the record: 200,000 som at the fixed 5 to the dollar is indeed 40,000. Ak's arithmetic is correct, which I note because it is a rare and joyful event. More important: "rest dismissed" means the land-transfer reporting stands.

threads.title: HEARD: Alikhan getting IradOne

posts.body: Heard: Alikhan Toktarov to be chairman of IradOne. Announcement soon.

The playboy. London college, Bishkek parties. And now he decides what Irad SEES. The eldest gets the guns, the second gets the cameras. Next son gets the bread and then we are finished.

WAKE UP IRAD
if he puts more telenovelas on, la Colonia will vote for him. just saying. mi abuela would carry his poster
It is official, Herald today. I put it on the Portal. The IradOne logo on the Portal is the old logo now, I will fix it
One request to the new chairman: Desert Sun's Rebellion in prime time. Restored print. That is all I have ever asked of any regime.
kino would sell the country for a restored print.
Yes.

threads.title: They struck Gritsenko and Melnikov off the ballot

posts.body:
The Territorial Election Commission struck the rivals off TODAY. Gritsenko, the union man from Nurzhan: "not enough verified signatures". Melnikov: "residence". The rules were written THIS YEAR by the DPI majority. First they write the rule, then they discover you broke it.

And this is the first election since they killed the term limit. Exactly what Gulya said in the other thread. EXACTLY.

WAKE UP IRAD

For accuracy: 10,000 verified signatures of registered voters, and ten years' continuous residence. "Verified" is the operative word. Verification against the registers is done by the Commission itself, with no independent check. That is the problem. Not the number.
half my street signed for Gritsenko. we watched the man with the clipboard. if they didn't count us i want my signature back
Refinery union signed in the canteen. Shift B, all of us. Apparently we don't exist. Grandmother's city doesn't exist, and now neither does shift B.
This one I don't need a source for. It's in the Herald tomorrow and it's on the Commission's own notice board tonight.
source_please agrees with me. Mark the date. 1 October 2015. The day the sceptic woke up.
Protest called in Nurzhan for Saturday. I am too old for running. I will stand at the back, near the bench.
Everybody who goes on Saturday: no names, no faces in photos, go home in pairs. Then come back here and tell us you're home.

Talas today: the square was full on the bazaar side, I could not count, nobody could. IradOne showed a flower festival. FLOWERS. Home, safe, angry.

WAKE UP IRAD

threads.title: State companies pulling ads from the Herald?

posts.body: Heard: since the October disqualification stories, several state firms have stopped buying ads in the Herald. Look at the paper, it's thinner.
it is thinner. today 16 pages and 4 of them were horses
Horses are the best four pages.

They punish the Herald for writing ONE brave sentence in ten years. I never thought I would type this: SUBSCRIBE TO THE HERALD.

WAKE UP IRAD

threads.title: That American on Debate One tonight??

posts.body: Who is the American on Debate One tonight? Caption says "Jason Ilyasov, Liberty Forum". He just told the Minister's man that the som should be "allowed to die with dignity". The presenter laughed and then looked at the camera like somebody was about to phone him.
He says he is Iradi. His Iradi is like my English after two beers. Good confidence, bad grammar.

An AMERICAN. On STATE TV. In PRIME TIME. Telling us to abolish the state. And they let him TALK for ten minutes without cutting to ads.

Nobody else gets ten minutes. Not the unions, not the clans, not Bekzatov. Ask yourself WHO decided this man gets ten minutes.

WAKE UP IRAD

I don't know him personally. Some of the younger people at the Iradi American Association say he spoke at a meeting once, about bitcoin, and the picnic committee did not invite him back. That is honestly all I know.

No feedback form this time. I am as confused as everybody.

[quote=UncleTemir_Chicago]I don't know him personally.[/quote]
Of course. Nobody from Chicago knows anybody from Chicago. VERY convenient.
Ak, Chicago has more people than Irad. Not everybody eats at the same picnic. Some of them eat at worse picnics.
He said one true thing tonight: Nurzhan's oil pays for the Talas towers. He said it in exactly the way that gets you a weekly slot instead of a visit. Watch.

Registered because of this thread. He's right about everything. The family owns the bank, the TV and the stadium, and our taxes go to the family. Taxation is theft. The rest of you are just scared to say it on camera.
If taxation is theft and the som should die with dignity, what do we buy bread with, Liberty?
Bitcoin.
my tía sells tamales for som, not for bitcoins. i asked her. she said no and gave me a tamal to stop talking

Second time on Debate One this month. I made a bingo card. Squares so far: "the som is a hostage", "free people, free horses", "in Chicago we...", presenter laughs nervously, Minister's man drinks water.

Full house in 14 minutes tonight. Card thread coming.

Bingo. You make GAMES while they put a CIA man on the screen every week. Next he gets his OWN show. Remember who said it.

WAKE UP IRAD
He has the face of the second villain in Zalmax's Dominion. The one who falls in the river in the last reel. I'm only saying the casting is good.
Watched him for the first time. Loud horse. Loud horses are not always fast.
Fast enough to get every Thursday on OneDebate. Neftchi gets fifteen seconds on OneNews if we win 4-0.

Five months. EVERY Thursday. Nobody else gets a Thursday. Only the American. And this forum makes BINGO CARDS.

I said it in February. I am saying it in July. In December you will all say "Ak was right" and I will not even be happy about it.

WAKE UP IRAD
To be fair, Ak, you did say it in February. You also said the 2013 horse flu was a bioweapon. You have a wide range.

Bumping for history. Two years of cards. He still doesn't have his own show, so that one's open. New squares for 2018: "blockchain", "the blockchain doesn't care who your father is", presenter checks earpiece.

threads.title: Debate One is now "OneDebate"?? IradOne renamed everything

posts.body:
Sat down for Debate One tonight and the titles said ONEDEBATE. The news at eight is now "OneNews at Eight". New jingle, same presenter, same tie.

I have twenty years of "IradOne News" idents on tape and since tonight they are history. Does anybody know why?
Somebody at IradOne hired a consultant. The consultant had a slideshow. The slideshow said "One".
New chairman since last summer. A new chairman wants new letters on the wall. That's all a rebrand ever is.
For the pedants: it's "OneNews", one word, capital N. My cousin's TV guide already printed "One News" and somebody at the printer is going to get a letter.

Don't laugh. NOTHING at IradOne changes by accident. A new chairman from the family changes the name of everything in ONE night and you think it's a CONSULTANT??

There is a reason. I don't know it yet. I WILL.

WAKE UP IRAD
I updated the TV page on the portal!! Now it says OneNews, OneDebate, OneTruth. The morning one I am not sure, is it OneBreakfast or Breakfast One?? sorry if broken
OneBreakfast. I checked. I stayed up for it, which is the opposite of breakfast.
IradOdin changed nothing, by the way. The Russian channel gets the old furniture, as usual.
Voices of Janyl kept its name. Parish co-production. Even IradOne knows you don't rebrand a liturgy.

[quote=seminarian_x]Voices of Janyl kept its name.[/quote]
Because the CHURCH said no. Who else in this country says no to them? NOBODY. Think about it.

Bumping this because of what happened in the Simpsons thread. In March he wrote "there is a reason, I don't know it yet. I WILL." Five months later he found it. ONE SONG.

Rest in peace, account.
came here from the Ak_Shumkar_Returns thread looking for the famous ONE theory. it's not even in this thread lol. it's just a guy saying "i will find out". iconic tho
It's in the Simpsons thread, page two. Bring snacks. Bring a chair.
Five years of One. Happy Irad Day. I still have the last "IradOne News" ident on tape, March 2016. Offers welcome.

threads.title: OneDebate bingo (Thursdays, 21:00)

posts.body:
As promised. Print it or copy it on paper. Free space in the middle.

[b]B[/b]: "the som is a hostage" / "free people, free horses" / "in Chicago we..." / "abolish" (any noun)
[b]I[/b]: presenter laughs nervously / Minister's man drinks water / camera cuts to the audience / someone says "with respect"
[b]N[/b]: "efficiency" / FREE SPACE (Ilyasov smiles at nothing) / "the family" (said, then not explained) / ad break mid-sentence
[b]G[/b]: "Liberty Forum" said 3+ times / "taxation" / "towers" / presenter touches earpiece
[b]O[/b]: anybody mentions horses / "Bitcoin" / "with all due respect" / show ends early

Post your score. No prizes. This is Irad.
"presenter laughs nervously" in the first 2 minutes. is that a record
24 out of 25. the only one missing was horses. how does nobody mention horses in irad for one hour
I can fix the horses square. Invite me.
Week 13. Nobody got full house because the Minister's man has stopped drinking water. He's learning. "Ad break mid-sentence" got it twice.
Leaving this on the rumour board. A list of what the state broadcaster lets an "opposition" man say every week is, technically, a leak.

threads.title: Abduction bill: who is really pushing it? (vote before 8 March?)

posts.body: HEARD: the abduction bill goes to the vote before Women's Day so the Governor can make a speech on 8 March. My cousin's wife works in the Mejlis canteen. She says the deputies were told to vote yes and give no interviews.

The deputies were not "told". They were shamed. Two years of women in white headscarves outside every district office in Kara-Buura. If somebody in Government House is now getting ready to take the credit, that is the oldest trick there is.

We will be in the gallery whatever day it is.

What the draft says, for people asking: a specific offence, 5 to 10 years, more if the girl is a minor, and registry offices barred from registering a marriage that began that way.

The last part is the clever part. A fine, you can pay. An unregistered marriage, you can't pay your way out of.
Rumour in Nurzhan: it's for the OSCE. Every report since 2011 has a paragraph about bride kidnapping. Pass a law, delete a paragraph.
Both can be true. A government can do the right thing for the wrong reason. I'll take it and thank the women.
Also HEARD: Anara Toktarova personally phoned the deputies who were against.
Source: cousin's wife. Location: canteen. Noted.

A gentle reminder for this thread. We do not name anybody involved in any case, and we do not guess about the families of individual deputies either. The Governor's wife is a public figure. Your neighbour is not. Read the rules.
In Tash-Kömür the old women say a law from Talas is like weather from the mountains: it arrives late and it lands differently. I hope this once they are wrong.
Passed. We were in the gallery. Nobody made a speech for us and nobody needed to. I will write properly tomorrow, tonight I just want to sit.
So the Women's Day thing was RIGHT!!
You said "before 8 March". It was on 8 March. Half a point. Somebody should keep score of this.

I'll keep score. Women's Day vote: half. The phone calls: unconfirmed, and likely to stay that way.

cousins_wife_says: 0.5 / 2.

threads.title: HEARD: the Altyn Tower is sinking

posts.body: My cousin's wife's sister cleans offices on the 19th floor. She says the doors don't close properly anymore and engineers come at night with lasers. The tower is SINKING. They will hide it until after the election.
The election is in 2019. That's a long time to hide a 27-storey building.

It's base-isolated, it's meant to move a little. Engineers come at night because in the day there are tenants. Your sister-in-law's door is a door.

statute_nerd, the book: 0.5 / 3.
I work on the 11th floor and our doors haven't closed properly since the day we moved in. Is my floor sinking too? Do I get a day off?

threads.title: Census: the number is already written (prediction thread)

posts.body:
Census enumerators start in the ISEZ next month. The Kurultai told them not to come to the tribal side, last year. So: how do you count people you're not allowed to count?

Predictions thread. Timestamped, so we can laugh later.
HEARD: for the tribal side they will take the old voter lists and "estimate". Estimate = make it small.

Nobody from Talas will come up here to count. The elders decided this in 2017 and I sat at the edge of one day of it. Whatever they write about us will be written in an office. Please do not expect me to be surprised by any number they print.

Enumerator came to our block in Nurzhan today. Young girl, tablet, very polite. Asked how many people live in the flat, ages, languages. Six minutes. She looked like she'd done four hundred of these and had four thousand to go.
in la Colonia my abuela asked to be counted twice, once Iradi and once Mexicana. the girl said one person one line. abuela says that is the problem with this country
Kara-Bulak, on the base road: nobody came yet. Maybe they count us as part of the base.
LEAK: the final number will be 4.6 million. Already decided in Government House. REMEMBER I SAID IT.
Logged, with timestamp. If it comes out at 4.6, I eat my hat.
Count the hats before you eat them.

Official result: 4,626,000.

I owe a hat. cousins_wife_says: 1.5 / 5. The real question is the one and a half million nobody counted, and I suspect The Erasure will have a thread on it by tonight.
Credit where due. Though "about 4.6 million" is also what you get if you take the 1989 number and add a little bit. Which may be exactly what happened.
I TOLD YOU. Somebody frame this.

Congratulations to cousins_wife_says on a correct prediction. I have prepared a short feedback form so members can rate the accuracy of rumours on this board, 1 to 5. I think it would raise the standard of the whole forum. Admins, may I post it?
STILL NO.

threads.title: Shooting on the western frontier? (herders talking)

posts.body: First post. Signal only at the truck stop. Two nights shooting at the wells west of here. Uzbek guards and our riders. Nobody knows who first. Herders moving flocks back from the line in the dark. Not rumour, I heard it with my ears.
Welcome. Nothing on OneNews, nothing on IradOdin. In this country that's a kind of confirmation.
People in my office say Iradiya cancelled today's Tashkent charter "for technical reasons". Technically: guns?
HEARD: twelve dead, the army is going west, Ruslan himself in command.

Which army? The State Defense Corps doesn't go onto the tribal side and neither does the Gendarmerie. The western desert is El-Choro country. If a column from Talas "went west" it would be a much bigger story than any border shooting.

Logged.
No army from Talas. Only riders. Not twelve dead. I do not know how many hurt. Nobody here says numbers. Numbers make revenge.

These are not our valleys, but the elders up here talk about it at every fire.

The trails and wells in the west are older than any line drawn in Tashkent or Moscow. Uzbek herders water at some of the same wells. If you take a well from a herder in June, you take his flock in August. I pray for cool heads, and I hope the Uzbek herders are speaking to their own guards the way our herders are speaking to our riders.
Nothing in the news here, of course. Is there a way for the diaspora to help the herders' families? Not politics. Just practical things.

Herald this morning: El-Choro patrols and Uzbek guards exchanged fire over grazing trails and boreholes, nobody gives casualty figures, Iradiya waiting for Tashkent landing permits. So the "technical reasons" were a permit.

western_wells: right. The twelve and the army: not.
cousins_wife_says: 0.5 / 4.

What they're saying in Nurzhan: Talas doesn't want a war on the border, but Talas doesn't mind the clans being busy with the Uzbeks either. Busy clans, quiet Kurultai. I'm not saying it's true. I'm saying it's what my uncle says over the beer.

I remember 1992, when every rumour of shooting became three rumours by morning, and the morning ones were always worse. Please, everyone, be careful what you repeat here. These are real families on both sides of the line.
In 1992 the first number was always wrong. The second number also. Wait for the third.
Quiet four nights. Our elders and Uzbek officers met at the old well by the road. UN men watching. Everybody drank tea and nobody smiled. That is good. When they smile, it is bad.
Water and grass. Every war in this country is about water and grass. The rest is speeches.

threads.title: Steppe Investigative Network: "The Dubai Villas"

posts.body:
For those inside who can't open it: the Steppe Investigative Network reports that Alikhan Toktarov bought three beachfront villas in Dubai worth more than $18 million, and alleges the money came from telecoms licensing fees. He says he paid from his own business income. Nobody has been charged with anything.

Read it on a VPN. Not at work.
I tried to work out how many refinery shifts $18 million is and the calculator ran out of zeros.
Telecoms licences. So every time Attelkom is slow, a wave hits a villa in Dubai.
This is literally what Ilyasov says every Thursday. State licence = family money. Abolish the licences.
Abolish the licences and the family simply owns the thing the licence was for. Same villa, fewer forms.
Is THIS why my webring is slow?? I also pay attelkom!! Where is my villa (sorry if broken)
Nothing on OneNews. OneBreakfast did a cooking segment on Dubai dates this morning, though. I'm not saying anything. I'm just saying dates.

threads.title: NurGaz tax bill: $212 million = punishment for Bekzatov?

posts.body: Herald: the tax service hands NurGaz a claim for $212 million in back taxes. Twelve years of "working arrangement" and suddenly somebody found an audit. In Nurzhan everyone says the same thing: Bekzatov talked too much on television.
if they touch nurgaz they touch neftchi. vyshka will remember this at the derby
It's a claim, not a judgment. NurGaz says its filings are fine and will appeal, and these things take years. The rumour is in the timing: five months before an election.
From inside the refinery: nobody is worried about the money. Everybody is worried about who gets audited next. Also the canteen soup got worse, but that started before the claim.
Our papers in Bishkek say Moscow will not be happy about this. I only report what the papers say. Please, nobody start the partition argument.
Two stallions, one paddock. Somebody loses a tooth.

threads.title: SIN report: Ruslan's companies and the air base diesel

posts.body:
New Steppe Investigative Network report: "Fences and Fuel: The Contracts behind Talas Air Base".

Summary, as neutral as I can make it: companies linked to Maj. Gen. Ruslan Toktarov held diesel supply contracts at the air base. That is what the report says. It does NOT prove smuggling, theft or anything else. Everything after this post is rumour. Say it anyway, but carefully.

I live on the base road. I have counted tankers since 2017, for my own reasons (I like trucks). A normal week: 30 to 40 in. Some weeks more tankers go out full than came in full. I don't know what that means. I only know how to count.

The report is careful, which is why it matters. A contract is not a crime. But supply contracts at a base, held by companies linked to the commander of the force that guards the base's outer perimeter, would be called a conflict of interest in any country that has that phrase in its dictionary.
For the hundredth time: not THAT Ruslan. I don't even have a car.
HEARD: the Americans are furious and will cancel all the contracts by the end of the year.
Bookkeeper's note: logged.

I wrote to my congressman's office to ask whether American contracting rules apply to fuel suppliers at Talas Air Base. I received a form letter. I am now sending them a feedback form about their form letter.
Temir sending a feedback form to Congress is the most diaspora thing that has ever happened on this forum.
Diesel in Chatkal: half again the Talas price. A base drinks a lot of diesel. Diesel walks. I already said this in another thread.
Up here we know the soodagers' trucks by their sound. Some of them carry papers nobody in our villages could ever get. I do not say whose papers. I say only that the papers are very good.
WE WILL BE WRITING ABOUT FUEL. WE ARE COLLECTING SOURCES. WHAT WE CANNOT PROVE, WE WILL SAY WE CANNOT PROVE.
Update for anyone counting with me. Last week, tankers out: 51. In: 33. Times, plates (first two letters only), direction, all in my notebook. Maybe they take empty ones out full of air.
PLEASE DO NOT POST THE NOTEBOOK. SUMMARISE THE NOTEBOOK.
Summary: more out than in.

Year-end bookkeeping. The Americans did not cancel anything, the contracts are still there as far as anybody can tell.

cousins_wife_says: 2.5 / 7.

threads.title: Tologonov out, Maksat in? (running mate rumours)

posts.body: HEARD: Tologonov will not be on the ticket in November. The son-in-law will. Same canteen. Statute, open your book.

Logged. For newer members: the running mate becomes Lieutenant Governor. Daniyar Tologonov has had the job since 2007 and he's 69. Aidar Maksat is Zara Toktarova's husband, civil engineer, the man who redid the Talas water mains. It's plausible, which is the worst kind of rumour to score.
He was born in Kobozev, before it was Nurzhan. Here people say "our boy" half proud, half the way you talk about a boy who moved to Talas and stopped calling his mother.
Born Maksatov, dropped the -ov as a student. In Nurzhan, dropping the -ov is a whole personality.

Up here they ask: if the son-in-law is second, who is third? When the head of a family names the son-in-law before the sons, there is a story behind it, and it is never a short story. The sons will be listening to every word of it.
Maksat is the only one of them who can read a spreadsheet. If it has to be one of them, fine.
"If it has to be one of them" is doing a lot of work in that sentence.
OneNews at Eight just confirmed it: joint ticket, Toktarov and Maksat. Tologonov "retires with the gratitude of the Republic". statute_nerd, your pen.
A clean point. cousins_wife_says: 2.5 / 6, with the American diesel one still pending.
The canteen is never wrong. (Except when it is.)
Reaction in my office: the Maksat people wore ties today. The Ruslan people went for a very long smoke.
Kyrgyz news says he was sworn in today. Congratulations or condolences, I'm not sure which is polite here.

Hello everyone. I am new here. Congratulations to Lieutenant Governor Maksat on his inauguration today, a great day for efficient government.

By the way, which cities is everyone posting from? Have a nice day. Remember to vote.
No.
Registered at ten in the morning on swearing-in day. Very normal. Welcome, normal person.

Herald profile today, "The Engineer Who Became Lieutenant Governor": father a metallurgist at the Chatkal antimony mill, Nurzhan Polytechnic, LSE on a territorial scholarship, then the water mains. There's nothing in it you could call a rumour, which is interesting in itself.
New horse in the stable. The old horses are looking at him.

threads.title: 2019 'election': 90.31%. Up twelve points for what?

posts.body: Results: 90.31%. In 2015 it was 78.25 and they had to strike everybody off the ballot to get it. This time nobody needed striking off. Twelve points up. For what? Who did he even beat?
free tamales at the polling station in la Colonia again. 78 last time, 90 now. the tamales are getting better every election, i can confirm
Official turnout 73.2%. The OSCE limited mission will say something like "lacked meaningful choice". At this point they could pre-print it.
The refinery voted by shift. Shift A at seven, Shift B at three. Foreman handed out the reminders like overtime slips. Nobody "had" to. Everybody did.
No out-of-country voting, again. Not that my vote would move 90.31%. I'd just like to be asked.
In 1994 I voted at a school in Alatau Heights. There were several names on the paper and I stood there and had to think. That is all I want for Irad. To have to think about it.

OneDebate election special. "Historic mandate" six times. "Stability" eleven. "The engineer" four. Ilyasov said "turnout is the only honest number on the screen" and they went to ads mid-sentence. Full house in 31 minutes.
I voted in every election since 1994. This was the fastest. In and out before I could think. Maybe that is the idea.
For comparison, in Kyrgyzstan our elections are very exciting. I'm not sure that is better either.
first time i could vote. no curtain on the booth. i voted with my arm around the paper like it was an exam
Ninety. A horse that wins every race by ninety lengths is running alone.

threads.title: Drones over the air base: whose?

posts.body: Herald confirms what the base road has seen since spring: small drones over the base and the approach road. Now there's "Operation Clear Skies": radars, jammers, double fence. Gendarmerie and American crews laid cable along our road for a month. My car radio crackles now every time I pass the gate.
HEARD: Chinese. Obviously.
Or Russian. Or Uzbek. Or a fourteen-year-old in Kara-Bulak with a birthday present. The Gendarmerie didn't say who, which means they don't know or don't want us to.
The Gendarmerie protects us from all threats. basewatcher_KB, which village on the base road do you live in exactly? Have a nice day.
No.
In Bishkek they say it is the Americans testing their own fence. I don't believe it, but it is the most Bishkek theory possible.
In Arslanbob we also have drones. Tourists fly them over the walnut forest to make videos. If one of them took a wrong turn for three hundred kilometres, I apologise on behalf of the walnuts.
Update: cable crews gone, fence doubled, my radio still crackles. Tankers per week: unchanged. Whatever they're protecting, the diesel still goes in and out.

threads.title: Internet down all day: backhoe or practice run?

posts.body: Are we back?? Since about ten this morning nothing foreign would load. No VPN, no email, the card machine at the bakery said no. Local sites fine. Attelkom says "technical work". Anybody?
Same in Nurzhan. Calls and SMS fine all day. Which is exactly the part you'd leave on if you were practising how to switch off the rest.
HEARD: DPI test for the next election. They are practising turning us off.
I thought I broke the webring!! I restarted the router 11 times and then once more for luck. It was NOT me?? First time it was not me!!
Kyrgyz news: a cable cut on a building site in Kazakhstan. Sometimes a backhoe is only a backhoe.

Herald: backhoe in Kazakhstan, nine hours, and Attelkom admits the switch to the backup routes "did not work as intended". So, not a practice run.

But now everybody knows the whole zone hangs on two cables into Kazakhstan and one into Uzbekistan. I promise you somebody in Government House read that sentence twice.

cousins_wife_says: 2.5 / 8.
A horse tied with three ropes. One rope breaks and the horse runs off. Bad knots.

threads.title: Taliban in Kabul: are they closing the passes?

posts.body: Kabul fell today. IradOne silent, IradOdin running Russian TV clips. Already hearing in Nurzhan that the MKK boys are called back from leave. Anybody?
Security at the refinery gate doubled at shift change tonight. No explanation. That's not a rumour, that's my bag being searched twice.
HEARD: thousands of refugees coming through the Fergana Rim.
With respect: Afghanistan does not border Irad. Or Kyrgyzstan. Tajikistan is in between, and Tajikistan has a lot of soldiers. Anyone coming has a very long walk through three countries.
Bishkek_Rail is correct about the map, which on this forum counts as irony. Logged.

Please, before it starts: we in the Rim are Muslims, not Taliban. My grandfather planted these walnut trees. Already today a man at the checkpoint asked my brother which mosque he goes to. He never asked that before.
fergana_walnut, nobody sensible on this board thinks that, and anybody who posts it will get a bowl of my aunt's laghman over the head. Metaphorically. Mostly.

OneNews at Eight, finally: "regional security alert", MKK reinforcing the mountain passes on the Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz borders. Same evening the IAC Chancellery says El-Choro riders are going up to the passes too. Both sides, same week, same passes.

Riders from our uruk went up to the pass road yesterday. I will say only what anyone there could see: Gendarmerie trucks were there too, and men from both sides shared tea and a radio frequency.

In 2007 they shot at each other on that road. I do not know if this makes me happy or afraid. Maybe both, like most things in this country.

From NurGaz people: the southern pipeline idea, the one to Pakistan the Americans always liked, is finished. Chevron people "reviewing". Nobody in Nurzhan is surprised. It was always a pipeline drawn on a slide.
Big planes at the base all week, landing at night. More than I have ever counted in one week. I don't know what they carry. I only count.
HEARD: they're flying Afghans in to the base.
Or cargo. Or soldiers going home. Or diesel, given who supplies it. Nobody here knows. Leave it.
Feast of St Janyl today, and The Steppe Family Robinson is on IradOne tonight like every year. In the middle of all this, Homer is still eating kazy at a border bazaar. Small mercies.

Closing the book on this one: no refugee columns in the Rim, the alert continues, the joint coordination at the passes continues. The airlift rumour stays unscored; we'll never know.

cousins_wife_says: 2.5 / 9.
The checkpoint man has stopped asking about mosques. Now he asks if we sell walnuts. Progress.

threads.title: Kurultai still going?? HEARD Talas will cut the power

posts.body: HEARD: the Kökjal elders want Toktogul back, and if they don't get it they will open the dam. Then Talas cuts the power to the whole tribal side in revenge. 100% from a man who drives for the Ministry.
i'm from the basin. nobody is opening any dam lol. my uncles are angry about money not water. the villages under the reservoir. compensation. that's it. please stop saying dam
Also, the dam's schedule is run by the joint commission under the protocol. Nobody "opens" Toktogul in a temper. Logged, generously.
HEARD in Nurzhan: Ruslan wants to send the Gendarmerie up to "help" the Kurultai decide faster. Not THAT Ruslan, the other one. Obviously.
Gendarmerie on the Aksay Plateau would be the end of the 2007 ceasefire, not the start of a deal. That's a bar rumour. Actual information is in the Valleys thread, from someone who is actually there.

from my cousin on the plateau: day 12 or 13, the old men are arguing about the 70s. the reservoir filled in my grandmother's time and when they argue they still say the names of the villages under the water. i didn't know the names. now i do
Bishkek rumour, for balance: the observers waiting in Tash-Kömür are so bored one of them bought a komuz. That is all. Nothing about partition.
HEARD: Maksat flew up to the plateau in a helicopter to negotiate in person.

No helicopter has landed at the Kurultai. If one had, the horses would have told you before I could.

The Kurultai does not negotiate with Talas. It decides what it will say to Talas. City people forget this difference.

it's done. my uncles stood aside. a fund for the basin families from our side's toktogul money. my uncle phoned me and said "they finally paid for the village names". i don't fully get it but he sounded happy. first time i ever followed politics

For the book: dam, no. Helicopter, no. (The Gendarmerie one was Ruslan's, not hers, and also no.)
